title: Alien messages may have reached Earth without us realizing it

The effect could be especially important around M-dwarf stars, the most common stars in the Milky Way.

title: Honey bees have their own personal flight paths and fly them with stunning precision

Landmarks like trees helped keep them on track, while uniform areas such as cornfields led to more variation.

title: Scientists crack a decades-old CO2 problem and triple fuel production

title: A dying star could create a new universe instead of a black hole

Driven by dark energy, this miniature cosmos would expand and push back against gravity, preventing complete collapse and creating an exotic object known as a gravastar.

title: Scientists discover parrots may actually use names

title: Yellowstone wolves may not have reshaped the national park after all
